failure.body:
Methods to disable links between the ToR and the fanout to simulate a link going down. (It may be better to make these fixtures instead so that the links can automatically be brought back up during test cleanup)

1. Shutdown the link between the fanout and the upper ToR
2. Shutdown the link between the fanout and the lower ToR
3. Shutdown the link between the upper ToR and the T1
4. Shutdown the link between the lower ToR and the T1

Depends on #2754

resolution.title: DualToR link failure utilities and fixtures
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #2756

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] Test case(new/improvement)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
This PR is to add link failure utilities and fixtures for dualToR  testing:
* Shutdown the link between the fanout and the upper ToR
* Shutdown the link between the fanout and the lower ToR
* Shutdown the link between the upper ToR and the T1
* Shutdown the link between the lower ToR and the T1

#### How did you do it?
Added new functions and fixtures in tests.common/dualtor/dual_tor_utils.py. Fixtures added:
* upper_tor_fanouthosts
* lower_tor_fanouthosts
* shutdown_fanout_upper_tor_intfs
* shutdown_fanout_lower_tor_intfs
* shutdown_fanout_tor_intfs
* shutdown_t1_upper_tor_intfs
* shutdown_t1_lower_tor_intfs
* shutdown_t1_tor_intfs

#### How did you verify/test it?
